subtitle_overlay: The one toggle that stopped the bleed
spoken_script: Cursor was sending my entire chat history on every single request. Every message. Every file. Every response — shipped again. That's insane. And I had no idea until my API bill showed up. Here's the thing — it's not a bug. It's a default setting. Finally, I figured it out. Go to Cursor Settings, open the Models tab, find 'Include conversation history' and toggle it off for long sessions. Wrong assumption: I thought the model was getting expensive. My bill dropped by almost forty percent the next day. Forty percent. I wasn't writing more code. I wasn't doing anything different. I was just sending the same tokens over and over. When AI starts burning money, check your context settings before you blame the model. That's all it is.

subtitle_overlay: One file. No more forgotten stack.
spoken_script: I ran Claude Code for a whole month without a CLAUDE.md file. And every single session — wrong framework, wrong conventions, wrong everything. I thought the model was failing me. Truth is, I was failing the model. Here's the thing: Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md automatically at session start. That's it. That's the secret. One file in your project root. I put my stack, my folder structure, my naming rules — all of it. Thirty lines, maybe five minutes to write. Claude stopped guessing. First session after I added it, zero corrections on conventions. Zero. Do this today — create CLAUDE.md in your root, drop your rules in plain English, commit it. That's all it is. One file and your agent finally remembers who you are.
